propositions: The idempotency integration test patches _now_iso only on binding_store_mod, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and related operations into binding_lifecycle, which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the freeze no longer reaches those operations.

The integration test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but its regression-detection reach is narrowed—it would no longer catch if clear_absent unconditionally stamps updated_at.

clear_absent is not executed during the healthy idempotency test fixture (all keys in-window; clear_absent only runs on out-of-window keys), so an unconditional-stamp mutation in clear_absent cannot drive the test RED via normal fixture execution.

The unit-tier test test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence already pins the no-stamp contract directly on the policy owner, containing the risk from narrowed integration coverage.
